claims.claim: The agent had no special skill instructions and relied on its own judgment plus the repo's AGENTS.md

eval_feedback.overall: This eval does not cleanly isolate the skill's contribution: the baseline run's own reasoning shows it was influenced by this repo's AGENTS.md ('always ask clarifying questions in planning mode'), which pushes toward the same behavior the skill also specifies. Both configurations converge on identical behavior (ask questions, write nothing) for this case, so this eval mainly proves the happy-path 'don't fabricate scope' behavior holds *somewhere* in the stack — it doesn't show the skill is doing unique work here. Consider either accepting this as an acceptable non-differentiating sanity check, or testing the vague-plan case in an eval harness without repo-level planning instructions to isolate the skill's own contribution.
